title: Pici with Wild Asparagus, Cream and Pecorino
description: Hand-rolled pici pasta in a peppery cacio e pepe style sauce with asparagus and a little cream, finished with butter and plenty of Pecorino.

steps.text: Place the flour in a large bowl and sprinkle in the water while kneading until a dough forms. Knead by hand for a few minutes until smooth. Cover with cling film and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

Pinch off small balls of dough and roll them into spaghetti-length snakes. Place on a tray dusted with durum flour. Boil in salted water for about 8 minutes until al dente. Reserve 3 tbsp of the cooking water.
Blanch the asparagus in boiling salted water for about 2 minutes.

Heat a little butter and the olive oil in a frying pan. Fry the sliced garlic, add plenty of black pepper and stir. Add the asparagus, pasta, the reserved cooking water, cream, salt and more pepper. Toss gently and adjust the seasoning.
Add 100 g cold cubed butter and the oregano to the pan and stir until the sauce coats the pasta. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with grated Pecorino.
